mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when this trigger is met, or the effect reverses for three consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) signals a consumption-led recession with a housing rebound, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST > previous 6-month average
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day returns in more than 70% of triggered episodes, or the relationship inverts for two consecutive recessions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% for three consecutive months, combined with rising industrial production (INDPRO), signals an overheating labor market and capacity constraint, which historically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipation of earnings growth.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.5% for three consecutive months AND INDPRO > previous 6-month average
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered episodes or the relationship fails for three consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) of less than 50,000 while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises signals labor market weakness, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened recession risk.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly change < 50,000 AND UNRATE monthly change > 0.2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 5-day returns in more than 70% of triggered episodes or the effect reverses for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which historically predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to lower earnings expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered months or the relationship inverts for three consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2% while the federal funds rate remains above 4.5% signals a disinflationary environment with restrictive policy, which historically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as markets anticipate rate cuts.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered episodes or the effect reverses during two consecutive disinflation episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real final sales of domestic product (proxied by GDPC1) above 0.5% while housing starts (HOUST) also rise signals broad-based demand expansion, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 monthly change > 0.5% AND HOUST monthly change > 1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered months or the relationship fails for three consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) greater than 0.4 percentage points while payroll employment (PAYEMS) rises by less than 30,000 signals a hollowing-out labor recovery, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to weak wage growth and consumer spending risks.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE monthly change < -0.4% AND PAYEMS monthly change < 30,000
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 5-day returns in more than 70% of triggered episodes or the effect reverses for two consecutive quarters.
